statement.sql:
declare @dbParam_UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER SET @dbParam_UserId =
Select * into #TempTable from (
Select 1 id,InternalOrglevel1 InternalOrglevel from RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RPIO inner join PEOPLE AP on RPIO.PersonId=AP.PersonId and ap.UserId=@dbParam_UserId union ALL Select 2 id,InternalOrglevel2 InternalOrglevel from RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RPIO inner join PEOPLE AP on RPIO.PersonId=AP.PersonId and ap.UserId=@dbParam_UserId union ALL Select 3 id,InternalOrglevel3 InternalOrglevel from RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RPIO inner join PEOPLE AP on RPIO.PersonId=AP.PersonId and ap.UserId=@dbParam_UserId union ALL Select 4 id,InternalOrglevel4 InternalOrglevel from RelPeopleInternalOrganizations RPIO inner join PEOPLE AP on RPIO.PersonId=AP.PersonId and ap.UserId=@dbParam_UserId ) temp
declare @tempXml xml
set @tempXml= ( Select
( Select AS1.UserId as '@id', Convert(varchar(40),SessionStartDateTime,9) as 'session/@startDate', isnull(SessionCounter,0) as 'session/@counter', Convert(varchar(40),SessionLastAccessDateTime,22) as 'session/@lastAccessDate', isnull(SessionCounter,0) as 'session/@sessionAccessCount', SessionId as 'session',
( select AU.DefaultRoleId as '@id', ( Select ARUR.RoleId as '@id' from AC_RelUserRole ARUR inner join AC_Role AR on ARUR.RoleId=ar.roleid where ARUR.userid=AS1.UserId and ar.ParentRoleId = AU.DefaultRoleId for xml path('currSubRole'),root('currSubRoles'),type ) for xml path('currRole'),type ) , AP.FirstName as 'firstName', AP.lastName as 'lastName', AU.UserName as 'userName', Convert(varchar(40),AU.LastLoginDateTime,22) as 'lastLoginDateTime', ( Select min(InternalOrglevel) '@lowestId' , (Select id 'intOrg/@id', InternalOrglevel 'intOrg' from #TempTable for xml path(''),type)
from #TempTable where InternalOrglevel <> 0 for XML path('intOrgs'), type), DATEDIFF(dd, getdate(), AU.ProfileExpirationDateTime ) as 'daysProfileValid' for xml path('user'),type ) from AC_SESSION AS1 inner join PEOPLE AP on AS1.UserId=AP.UserId inner join AC_USER AU on AS1.UserId=AU.UserId
where AS1.UserId=@dbParam_UserId for XML Path(''),root('sessionInfo') )
Drop Table #TempTable
Select @tempXml
